Package io.telekom.orchest.adapter.mongo

Class MongoUserTaskRepositoryAdapter

java.lang.Object
io.telekom.orchest.adapter.mongo.MongoUserTaskRepositoryAdapter
All Implemented Interfaces:
io.telekom.orchest.api.core.adapters.data.repository.UserTaskRepository
@Repository public class MongoUserTaskRepositoryAdapter extends Object implements io.telekom.orchest.api.core.adapters.data.repository.UserTaskRepository
MongoDB implementation of the UserTaskRepository. Adapts the Spring Data MongoDB repository to the domain-agnostic repository interface. Manages the full lifecycle of user task instances (create, claim, complete, cancel).
